    // above solution giving tle we can use binary search for it;
        // min will be zero and max will be integer max;
        
       //  handling edge cases;
        if(x==0)
            return 0;
        int si =0;
        int ei = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        while(true){
            int mid = (si+ei)/2;
            // here x/mid because mid and x will give the square
            if(mid>(x/mid))
               ei = mid-1;
            else{
                if (mid + 1 > x/(mid + 1))
                    return mid;
                si = mid+1;
            }
               
        }
    }
}
